sentences.en: I cursed myself for not bringing a flashlight as I felt around the walls for a light switch.

sentences.en: New, disease resistant trees are bringing back the splendor of what has been called one of the prettiest towns in New England.

sentences.en: Bringing an end to poverty, then, will also help bring an end to hunger.
